Looking at the evidence, I'll evaluate each column's usefulness and groundedness.

Key issue: `has_technical_issue` produces "0" for CS-0002 (session drops - clearly technical) and CS-0005 (BOM character bug - clearly technical), only marking CS-0003 as technical. This is poorly grounded. `affects_multiple_users` marks CS-0004 (single power-user enhancement request) as "1" with no support, and CS-0002 as "0" though it's arguably correct.

```json
{
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "has_technical_issue", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.3, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "A technical vs non-technical split is a genuinely useful axis for predicting resolution time. However the values contradict the source: CS-0002 (session-drop bug) and CS-0005 (BOM export bug) are plainly technical yet labelled 0, undermining groundedness."},
    {"name": "is_customer_blocked", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Whether the customer is blocked is a strong signal for urgency/effort. Labels are mostly defensible (CS-0003 outage blocking a presentation = 1), though CS-0002/CS-0005 as 'blocked' is a stretch (they have workarounds), a mild overreach."},
    {"name": "needs_investigation", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.7, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Whether a ticket requires investigation/RCA is a plausible driver of longer resolution. CS-0003 (RCA requested) correctly 1; CS-0002 (suspected SSO push needing confirmation) and CS-0005 (diagnosing BOM cause) arguably warrant investigation but are 0, a somewhat conservative but not clearly wrong read."},
    {"name": "has_external_integration", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "External integration (SSO, Snowflake pipeline) adds coordination complexity, a reasonable signal. Values are well grounded: CS-0002 (SSO) and CS-0005 (Snowflake) correctly 1, CS-0001 billing correctly 0."},
    {"name": "affects_multiple_users", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.4, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Scope of impact is a solid axis for resolution effort, but grounding is weak: CS-0004 (single power-user enhancement) marked 1 with no support, while CS-0002 (single user) is 0 as expected. The high 1-rate (115) plus the CS-0004 error suggest over-assertion."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.82,
  "source_groundedness": 0.6,
  "rationale": "All five columns give binary complexity/impact signals that are genuinely relevant to predicting longer resolution times, offering distinct axes (technical nature, blocking, investigation, integration, scope) rather than restatements—so analytical usefulness is high. Groundedness is mixed: has_external_integration and needs_investigation are well-read from the text, but has_technical_issue mislabels obvious technical bugs as non-technical, and affects_multiple_users asserts multi-user impact for a clearly single-user enhancement request, both indicating hallucinated values that a strict evaluator must penalise."
}
```
